title: Abstract a prophylactic antibiotic record
brief:
Your hospital is auditing compliance with the prophylactic antibiotic measure for surgical patients. The measure criterion is: **a prophylactic antibiotic must be documented as given within 60 minutes before the skin incision.**

Review the patient record below. Then complete the abstraction form.

task.stem: Complete the abstraction form using the patient record above.

record.title: Patient Record — Case #D-14 · General Surgery Ward

fields.label: Is this case eligible for abstraction? (Inpatient surgery, patient ≥ 18 years, procedure on the measure list)
Was a prophylactic antibiotic ordered before the operation?

options.label: Unable to determine from the record

fields.label: Is the administration time documented so you can check the 60-minute criterion?
What is the correct abstraction result for this case?

options.label: Criterion met — antibiotic given within 60 minutes of incision
Criterion not met — antibiotic not given within 60 minutes
Exclude from measure — insufficient data to determine timing

debrief.correct: Correct. The antibiotic was ordered, but the administration time was never recorded. Without a documented time, you cannot determine whether the 60-minute criterion was met. The correct abstraction result is **exclude** — not 'met' and not 'not met'. Counting this case as a failure would unfairly penalise the team if the antibiotic was actually given on time. Counting it as a pass would inflate the compliance rate. Exclusion flags the documentation gap so it can be fixed.
debrief.wrong: Trace through each field. The case is eligible (inpatient surgery, adult, appendectomy is on the measure list). An antibiotic was ordered (Cefazolin 1 g IV at 09:15). But the administration time is not recorded — so you cannot calculate the interval to the 10:45 incision. When you cannot determine timing from the record, the correct abstraction is 'exclude from measure due to insufficient data' — not 'met' (you do not know) and not 'not met' (you also do not know).
debrief.rule_cited: Chart abstraction — data completeness and exclusion rules. NAHQ HQ Essentials: Chart Abstraction for Quality Measurement.
